    AI Overview
    Andrej Stojakovic, son of former NBA All-Star Peja Stojakovic, plays for the Illinois Fighting Illini as of the 2025-26 season. He is a guard/forward who transferred to Illinois after playing for California (2024-25) and Stanford (2023-24). He is known as a high-scoring transfer who committed to Illinois in April 2025. 
    • Current Team: University of Illinois (2025-present).
    • Previous Teams: Stanford (2023-24), California (2024-25).
    • Background: 6-foot-7 guard/forward from Carmichael, California, and former McDonald's All-American.
    • Performance:
      He averaged 17.9 points per game during the 2024-25 season with Cal.
       
    This information is based on reports from March/April 2025 and into the 2026 NCAA tournament season.
